## Evidence checklist

- [ ] Material factual claims cite primary sources where available.
- [ ] Reported facts are separated from project interpretation.
- [ ] Unsupported metrics and mechanisms are marked unknown.
- [ ] The observable and its units or population are named.
- [ ] Curve descriptions are separated from causal geometries.
- [ ] Competing interpretations and confidence are recorded.
- [ ] Proposed controls trace to an observed property and include a verification test.
